title: What is PEGA BPM?
learning_objectives: Understand what Business Process Management (BPM) means
Learn the key features and benefits of PEGA BPM
Distinguish between case management and traditional workflow

introduction.title: Introduction to PEGA BPM
introduction.text: PEGA Business Process Management (BPM) is a comprehensive platform that enables organizations to design, execute, monitor, and optimize business processes. It combines case management capabilities with traditional workflow management to create powerful, adaptive business applications that can handle both structured and unstructured work.

sections.title: What is Business Process Management?
sections.content: Business Process Management (BPM) is a discipline that focuses on improving business performance by managing and optimizing business processes. It involves analyzing, designing, implementing, monitoring, and continuously improving business processes to achieve organizational goals more efficiently.
key_points: BPM is about managing and optimizing business processes
It involves the entire lifecycle from design to optimization
The goal is to improve business performance and efficiency
BPM combines people, processes, and technology

sections.title: PEGA BPM Platform Overview
sections.content: PEGA BPM is a unified platform that provides everything needed to build, deploy, and manage business applications. It stands out from other BPM solutions by offering a low-code development environment that makes it accessible to both business users and professional developers.
key_points: Unified platform for complete application development
Accessible to both business users and developers

sections.title: Key Features of PEGA BPM
sections.content: PEGA BPM offers several distinctive features that set it apart from traditional BPM solutions.

subsections.title: Case Management
subsections.content: Unlike traditional workflow systems that follow predefined paths, PEGA's case management approach handles complex, knowledge-intensive processes that require human judgment and can adapt to changing circumstances.
benefits: Provides complete case context and history

subsections.title: Low-Code Development
subsections.content: PEGA's low-code platform enables rapid application development with minimal traditional coding, making it accessible to business users while still providing the power that developers need.
benefits: Business users can participate in development

subsections.title: Business Rules Engine
subsections.content: PEGA includes a powerful business rules engine that allows business logic to be defined declaratively, making it easy to understand, maintain, and modify without traditional programming.
benefits: Rules can be changed without coding
Enables business users to manage rules

subsections.title: Integration Capabilities
subsections.content: PEGA provides robust integration capabilities to connect with existing systems, databases, web services, and third-party applications, ensuring that new applications can work seamlessly with your current technology landscape.

sections.title: Case Management vs Traditional Workflow
sections.content: Understanding the difference between case management and traditional workflow is crucial to appreciating PEGA's unique approach to BPM.

traditional_workflow.description: Traditional workflow systems are designed for predictable, structured processes with predefined sequences of activities.

case_management.description: Case management is designed for complex, knowledge-intensive work that requires human judgment and can't be fully automated.

sections.title: Benefits of PEGA BPM
sections.content: Organizations choose PEGA BPM for its unique combination of power, flexibility, and ease of use.

sections.title: Real-World Applications
sections.content: PEGA BPM is used across various industries to solve complex business challenges.

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: PEGA BPM is a comprehensive platform for building business applications
It combines case management with traditional workflow capabilities
The low-code approach makes it accessible to business users
Case management is ideal for complex, knowledge-intensive processes
PEGA provides built-in integration, rules engine, and analytics
It's used across industries for various business applications

next_steps.title: What's Next?
next_steps.text: Now that you understand what PEGA BPM is and its key benefits, the next tutorial will dive deeper into PRPC (PEGA Rules Process Commander), the underlying platform that powers PEGA applications.
